name: building-blocks-layout-primitives

description: Structural Tailwind layout blocks for vertical stacks, readable containers, and inline clusters.
useWhen: Structural Tailwind layout blocks for vertical stacks, readable containers, and inline clusters.
avoidWhen: Avoid layout primitives when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Layout Primitives uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
